Name: General Data Protection Regulation (Regulation (EU) 2016/679)
Issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
Description: EU regulation on the protection of natural persons with regard to the processing of personal data and on the free movement of such data.

Name: California Consumer Privacy Act, as amended by the California Privacy Rights Act
Description: California Civil Code, Title 1.81.5, sections 1798.100 et seq. Consumer rights to know, delete, correct, opt out of sale or sharing and limit the use of sensitive personal information.

Name: Artificial Intelligence Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689)
Issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
Description: EU regulation laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence, including data governance, transparency and human oversight requirements for high-risk AI systems.

Name: ISO 3166-1 Codes for the representation of names of countries and their subdivisions - Part 1: Country code
Description: Alpha-2, alpha-3 and numeric country codes, maintained by the ISO 3166 Maintenance Agency.

Name: ISO 4217 Codes for the representation of currencies
Description: Three-letter alphabetic and three-digit numeric currency codes, with the number of minor units.

Name: ISO 639 Codes for individual languages and language groups
Description: Language identifiers, including the two-letter set (formerly ISO 639-1) used for major languages such as en and fr.

Name: ISO 8601 Date and time - Representations for information interchange
Description: Unambiguous representation of dates, times, durations and time zone offsets (e.g. 2026-12-11, 2026-12-11T14:30:00Z).

Name: ITU-T Recommendation E.164 The international public telecommunication numbering plan
Description: International telephone numbering plan: country code followed by the national significant number, maximum 15 digits.

Name: ISO 13616-1 Financial services - International bank account number (IBAN)
Description: Structure of the IBAN: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, two check digits (MOD 97-10) and a country-specific basic bank account number. SWIFT is the registration authority.

Name: ISO 17442 Financial services - Legal entity identifier (LEI)
Description: 20-character alphanumeric identifier of legal entities, with two check digits (ISO/IEC 7064 MOD 97-10). Operated by GLEIF.

Name: GS1 Global Trade Item Number (GTIN)
Description: Identifier of trade items (GTIN-8, GTIN-12, GTIN-13, GTIN-14) defined by the GS1 General Specifications, ending with a modulo-10 check digit.

Name: ISO 8000 Data quality (series)
Description: Series of standards on data quality and master data quality, including ISO 8000-8 (quality concepts and measurement), ISO 8000-61 (data quality management process reference model) and ISO 8000-110 (master data exchange and conformance to a data specification).

Name: ISO/IEC 11179 Metadata registries (MDR) (series)
Description: Metadata registry framework: registry metamodel (Part 3), formulation of data definitions (Part 4) and naming principles (Part 5).

Name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Information security, cybersecurity and privacy protection - Information security management systems - Requirements
Description: Requirements for an information security management system; Annex A lists 93 information security controls.

Name: BCBS 239 Principles for effective risk data aggregation and risk reporting
Description: Fourteen principles (January 2013) on governance, data architecture, accuracy, completeness, timeliness and adaptability of risk data. Used here as good practice for reporting-grade master data.

Name: Consumer Packaging and Labelling Act (R.S.C. 1985, c. C-38) and Consumer Packaging and Labelling Regulations (C.R.C., c. 417)
Description: Federal law governing the labelling of prepackaged consumer products in Canada, including the requirement to show mandatory label information in both official languages (English and French).

Name: Charter of the French Language (CQLR c. C-11), as amended by Bill 96 (S.Q. 2022, c. 14)
Description: Quebec law making French the official language; requires French on product inscriptions, packaging, instructions, catalogues and brochures. Strengthened by Bill 96, An Act respecting French, the official and common language of Quebec.

Name: DAMA-DMBOK: Data Management Body of Knowledge, 2nd edition
Description: Reference framework for data management knowledge areas: governance, modeling, security, reference and master data, metadata, data quality.

Name: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records; Electronic Signatures
Description: FDA criteria under which electronic records and electronic signatures are considered trustworthy, reliable and equivalent to paper records.

Name: EudraLex Volume 4, EU GMP Annex 11: Computerised Systems
Description: EU Good Manufacturing Practice guidance for computerised systems used in GMP-regulated activities (revision in force since 30 June 2011).

Name: ISO 11615 Health informatics - Identification of medicinal products (IDMP) - Data elements and structures for the unique identification and exchange of regulated medicinal product information
Description: IDMP standard defining the Medicinal Product Identifier (MPID) and the data elements describing a regulated medicinal product.

Name: ISO 11616 Health informatics - Identification of medicinal products (IDMP) - Data elements and structures for the unique identification and exchange of regulated pharmaceutical product information
Description: IDMP standard defining the Pharmaceutical Product Identifier (PhPID), based on substances, strength and dose form.

Name: HIPAA Privacy and Security Rules (45 CFR Parts 160 and 164)
Issuer: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services
Description: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act rules protecting individually identifiable health information (PHI) held by covered entities and business associates.

Name: HIPAA Administrative Simplification: Standard Unique Health Identifier for Health Care Providers (45 CFR Part 162, Subpart D)
Issuer: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services
Description: Adopts the National Provider Identifier (NPI), a 10-digit identifier with a Luhn check digit, as the standard identifier of health care providers.

Name: Physician Payments Sunshine Act (42 U.S.C. 1320a-7h) and Open Payments regulations (42 CFR Part 403, Subpart I)
Issuer: U.S. Congress / Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services
Description: Section 6002 of the Affordable Care Act. Applicable manufacturers report payments and other transfers of value to covered recipients (physicians, teaching hospitals and other practitioners) to CMS Open Payments.

Name: 21 CFR Part 207 Establishment registration and drug listing, National Drug Code
Description: Drug listing requirements and the National Drug Code (NDC): labeler, product and package code segments, currently 10 digits in a 4-4-2, 5-3-2 or 5-4-1 configuration.
